title: Vercel is easiest place to ship your vibe-coded app and that ease is exactly what you're paying for
description:
You put your vibe-coded app on Vercel because it was easy. That easy is exactly what you're paying for every month.

The honest part first: Vercel really is the easiest way to ship, you push and you're live in seconds, and if your bill doesn't hurt yet you should probably stay. But picture cloud hosting as a building. The ground floor is real servers: Amazon, Microsoft, Google. Vercel doesn't own servers, it's a beautiful room built on top of Amazon, and the rent is the convenience. Cloudflare sits near the ground floor on its own worldwide network, with a famously generous free tier, so real traffic barely moves the bill.

The only real blocker was the dashboard, a hundred menus you don't recognize. That excuse died when Cloudflare shipped an official plugin for Claude Code: one command to install, then your agent deploys the app, creates the database, wires storage and DNS, and reads the logs from the terminal. You never open the dashboard, and you pay almost nothing.
